home: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished Bilibili videogame thumbnail, exact landscape 4:3 canvas, preferably 1440x1080. Reference 1 is the actual v0.3.0 game artillery and Chinese gatehouse, reference 2 actual blue-grey box-shaped low-poly player. Keep this unmistakable simple blocky low-poly game aesthetic and these same object silhouettes, do not turn it into realistic AAA graphics or actors. Independently compose a bold cover: huge olive green Italian field cannon firing diagonally toward the red Chinese gatehouse, orange geometric muzzle flash and a few angular tower fragments, enlarged grey-blue blocky soldier with cap beside cannon. One strong diagonal connects cannon and tower. Warm dusty ochre environment, dark outlines, high contrast. No HUD, chat, reticle, controls, logos, watermarks, extra vehicles or army. Huge clear simplified Chinese main type '开炮！' and smaller subheadline '打进平安县城', tiny game label '枪火集结'. Short readable typography with safe margins, central important objects safe for alternate widescreen composition. This is illustrated promotional recomposition based on actual game, not a claimed screenshot. Exact 4:3, not 3:2.
space: Recompose exact 16:9 widescreen from approved 4:3 cover. Keep blocky blue-grey soldier, olive cannon, collapsing red Chinese tower, warm ochre palette; exact text 开炮！ / 打进平安县城 / 枪火集结; preserve all subjects and words.
export: Separate compositions, normalized to 1440x1080 and 1920x1080, JPEG quality 2; tiny aspect normalization for model output.
